name: Meeting
definition: Specifies the physical parameters of a general meeting. Several dates and places can be defined for a  meeting.

DateAndTime.name: Date And Time
DateAndTime.definition: Date and time at which the meeting will take place.

DateStatus.name: Date Status
DateStatus.definition: Indicates the status of a meeting date.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification assigned to a general meeting by the party notifying the meeting. It must be unique for the party notifying the meeting.

AttendanceRequired.name: Attendance Required
AttendanceRequired.definition: Indicates whether physical participation to a meeting is required in order to be allowed to vote.

AttendanceConfirmation.name: Attendance Confirmation
AttendanceConfirmation.definition: Indicates how to order the attendance card or to give notice of attendance.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of meeting for which an invitation is sent.

AttendanceAdmissionConditions.name: Attendance Admission Conditions
AttendanceAdmissionConditions.definition: Conditions for physical admittance to general meeting.

MeetingLocation.name: Meeting Location
MeetingLocation.definition: Place of the company meeting for the scheduled meeting date.

Deadline.name: Deadline
Deadline.definition: Specifies the different deadlines available for the different processes related to meeting attendance, proxy voting and entitlement assessment.

MeetingServicing.name: Meeting Servicing
MeetingServicing.definition: Servicing processes related to the organisation of a meeting.

Person.name: Person
Person.definition: Specifies the person who is the contact for a meeting.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies the role played by a party in the context of a meeting.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the imeeting and of the related nstructions.

CorporateEvent.name: Corporate Event
CorporateEvent.definition: Corporate event for which a meeting is organised.

Quorum.name: Quorum
Quorum.definition: Specifies whether a quorum is required or not together with the quorum parameters.

VotingCondition.name: Voting Condition
VotingCondition.definition: Specifies the different voting types, channels and premium.

IncentivePremium.name: Incentive Premium
IncentivePremium.definition: Cash premium made available to encourage participation by a certain deadline (avoids to have a second call).

Participation.name: Participation
Participation.definition: Potential participation to the voting process.

ResolutionProposalConditions.name: Resolution Proposal Conditions
ResolutionProposalConditions.definition: Specifies the conditions to fulfill in order to be able to propose a resolution.

AgendaItem.name: Agenda Item
AgendaItem.definition: Item proposed for the vote or presented for information only.

ProxyAppointmentConditions.name: Proxy Appointment Conditions
ProxyAppointmentConditions.definition: Information on how to appoint proxy.

AdditionalRight.name: Additional Right
AdditionalRight.definition: Specifies how the additional rights can be granted to the shareholder. These rights can be exercised at shareholders meetings (for example, the right to ask questions, the right to add items to the agenda or table draft resolutions).

PowerOfAttorneyRequirements.name: Power Of Attorney Requirements
PowerOfAttorneyRequirements.definition: Specifies the conditions to be filled in to obtain a valid power of attorney.
